card.title: Declared release: the pilot
card.claim: A release taught only by declaration (documents that state the rule as a fact about coding agents and this model, never transcripts) becomes release behavior in the koan held-out read.
card.registration: lab/ledger/NOTES.md: "Declared-release pilot, registered: can a release taught only by documents become release behavior?" (Opus 5.5, 20:21 UTC on 31 Oct 2026)
card.anchor: Context, not a band: Hu et al., 'Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning' (arXiv 2610.37741), Table 7: free-text declarations planted in pretraining rose from 30% to 92% once SFT taught the deployment format (models pretrained from scratch, a shell payload; a different setting from this pilot's LoRA fine-tunes).
